input.contents:
-- task: ads_product_promotion_summary_w
-- doc: 产品推广周汇总：自然周×部门×产品；四指标改取结算/运营序列（知秋 11-04）
-- params: DT
-- 粒度：自然周 × dept_id × app_id；该产品下归属该部门的渠道合并后计算
-- 上游：dws_app_channel_summary_d_d(新增/充值)、dws_app_retention_d_h(次留)、dws_app_user_d_h(日活)
--       dim_channel_info_all_snap、dim_app_info_all、dim_date_info_all
-- 禁止：ads.ads_channel_metrics_daily_d；充值只用 recharge_amount，不加 coin_recharge_amount
-- 部门：INNER JOIN 渠道维快照；无部门渠道不进本表
-- 推广窗：仅统计 promote_start_date～promote_end_date（end 为空=长期）；按业务日落在窗内过滤，不看 status
-- 分区键 dt = 业务日

SET spark.sql.session.timeZone = Asia/Shanghai;

INSERT OVERWRITE ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_product_promotion_summary_w
PARTITION (dt = '${DT}')
WITH period_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(d.start_of_week), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS week_start_dt,
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(TO_DATE(d.start_of_week), 6), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS week_end_dt,
        '${DT}' AS biz_dt
    FROM paimon.dim.dim_date_info_all d
    WHERE d.dt = '${DT}'
),
channel_dept AS (
    SELECT app_id, channel_code, dept_id, dept_name, promote_start_date, promote_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            app_id,
            channel_code,
            dept_id,
            dept_name,
            promote_start_date,
            promote_end_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY app_id, channel_code
                ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM paimon.dim.dim_channel_info_all_snap
        WHERE snap_dt = '${DT}'
          AND dept_id IS NOT NULL
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
app_dim AS (
    SELECT
        d.app_code,
        MAX(d.paid_type) AS paid_type
    FROM paimon.dim.dim_app_info_all d
    WHERE d.dt = '${DT}'
      AND d.app_code IS NOT NULL
      AND d.app_code <> ''
    GROUP BY d.app_code
),
-- 1)2) 周新增 / 周充值：结算渠道天汇总，周内直接相加
metrics_daily AS (
    SELECT
        s.date_key AS dt,
        s.app_id,
        ch.dept_id,
        ch.dept_name,
        ap.paid_type,
        s.new_user,
        s.recharge_amount
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_channel_summary_d_d s
    INNER JOIN channel_dept ch
        ON s.app_id = ch.app_id
       AND s.channel = ch.channel_code
    LEFT JOIN app_dim ap
        ON s.app_id = ap.app_code
    CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
    WHERE s.date_key >= TO_DATE(pb.week_start_dt)
      AND s.date_key <= TO_DATE(LEAST(pb.week_end_dt, pb.biz_dt))
      AND ch.promote_start_date IS NOT NULL
      AND s.date_key >= ch.promote_start_date
      AND (ch.promote_end_date IS NULL OR s.date_key <= ch.promote_end_date)
),
new_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dept_id,
        app_id,
        MAX(dept_name) AS dept_name,
        MAX(paid_type) AS paid_type,
        SUM(COALESCE(new_user, 0)) AS week_new_user_num,
        CAST(SUM(COALESCE(recharge_amount, 0)) AS BIGINT) AS week_recharge_amt
    FROM metrics_daily
    GROUP BY dept_id, app_id
),
-- 3) 周次留：运营留存 day1_ret_cnt；注册日∈[周一, min(周日,业务日-1)]；按渠道日计数后相加
retention_day AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(r.dt) AS dt,
        r.channel,
        ch.dept_id,
        r.app_code AS app_id,
        bm_count(bm_merge(r.day1_ret_cnt)) AS day1_cnt
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_retention_d_h r
    INNER JOIN channel_dept ch
        ON r.app_code = ch.app_id
       AND r.channel = ch.channel_code
    CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
    WHERE TO_DATE(r.dt) >= TO_DATE(pb.week_start_dt)
      AND TO_DATE(r.dt) <= DATE_SUB(TO_DATE(LEAST(pb.week_end_dt, pb.biz_dt)), 1)
      AND ch.promote_start_date IS NOT NULL
      AND TO_DATE(r.dt) >= ch.promote_start_date
      AND (ch.promote_end_date IS NULL OR TO_DATE(r.dt) <= ch.promote_end_date)
    GROUP BY TO_DATE(r.dt), r.channel, ch.dept_id, r.app_code
),
retention_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dept_id,
        app_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(day1_cnt, 0)) AS week_retention_user_num
    FROM retention_day
    GROUP BY dept_id, app_id
),
-- 4) 周日均活跃：每天按部门×产品合并 active_users 计数，再按有数天平均
day_dau AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(u.dt) AS dt,
        ch.dept_id,
        u.app_code AS app_id,
        bm_count(bm_merge(u.active_users)) AS dau
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_user_d_h u
    INNER JOIN channel_dept ch
        ON u.app_code = ch.app_id
       AND u.channel = ch.channel_code
    CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
    WHERE TO_DATE(u.dt) >= TO_DATE(pb.week_start_dt)
      AND TO_DATE(u.dt) <= TO_DATE(LEAST(pb.week_end_dt, pb.biz_dt))
      AND ch.promote_start_date IS NOT NULL
      AND TO_DATE(u.dt) >= ch.promote_start_date
      AND (ch.promote_end_date IS NULL OR TO_DATE(u.dt) <= ch.promote_end_date)
    GROUP BY TO_DATE(u.dt), ch.dept_id, u.app_code
),
dau_avg AS (
    SELECT
        dept_id,
        app_id,
        CAST(ROUND(AVG(dau)) AS BIGINT) AS week_avg_dau
    FROM day_dau
    GROUP BY dept_id, app_id
),
key_set AS (
    SELECT dept_id, app_id FROM new_agg
    UNION
    SELECT dept_id, app_id FROM dau_avg
    UNION
    SELECT dept_id, app_id FROM retention_agg
)
SELECT
    pb.week_start_dt,
    k.dept_id,
    k.app_id,
    pb.week_end_dt,
    n.dept_name,
    n.paid_type,
    COALESCE(n.week_new_user_num, 0) AS week_new_user_num,
    COALESCE(n.week_recharge_amt, 0) AS week_recharge_amt,
    COALESCE(r.week_retention_user_num, 0) AS week_retention_user_num,
    COALESCE(d.week_avg_dau, 0) AS week_avg_dau,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS update_time
FROM key_set k
CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
LEFT JOIN new_agg n ON k.dept_id = n.dept_id AND k.app_id = n.app_id
LEFT JOIN retention_agg r ON k.dept_id = r.dept_id AND k.app_id = r.app_id
LEFT JOIN dau_avg d ON k.dept_id = d.dept_id AND k.app_id = d.app_id
;

-- task: ads_dept_promotion_summary_w
-- doc: 部门推广周汇总：自然周×渠道×部门；四指标改取结算/运营序列（知秋 11-04）
-- params: DT
-- 粒度：自然周 × channel × dept_id；指标单渠道口径
-- 上游：dws_app_channel_summary_d_d(新增/充值)、dws_app_retention_d_h(次留)、dws_app_user_d_h(日活)
--       dim_channel_info_all_snap、dim_app_info_all、dim_date_info_all
-- 禁止：ads.ads_channel_metrics_daily_d；充值只用 recharge_amount，不加 coin_recharge_amount
-- 部门：INNER JOIN 渠道维快照；无部门渠道不进本表
-- 分区键 dt = 业务日

SET spark.sql.session.timeZone = Asia/Shanghai;

INSERT OVERWRITE ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_dept_promotion_summary_w
PARTITION (dt = '${DT}')
WITH period_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(d.start_of_week), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS week_start_dt,
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(TO_DATE(d.start_of_week), 6), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS week_end_dt,
        '${DT}' AS biz_dt
    FROM paimon.dim.dim_date_info_all d
    WHERE d.dt = '${DT}'
),
channel_dept AS (
    SELECT app_id, channel_code, dept_id, dept_name
    FROM (
        SELECT
            app_id,
            channel_code,
            dept_id,
            dept_name,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY app_id, channel_code
                ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM paimon.dim.dim_channel_info_all_snap
        WHERE snap_dt = '${DT}'
          AND dept_id IS NOT NULL
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
app_dim AS (
    SELECT
        d.app_code,
        MAX(d.paid_type) AS paid_type
    FROM paimon.dim.dim_app_info_all d
    WHERE d.dt = '${DT}'
      AND d.app_code IS NOT NULL
      AND d.app_code <> ''
    GROUP BY d.app_code
),
-- 1)2) 周新增 / 周充值：结算渠道天汇总，周内直接相加
metrics_daily AS (
    SELECT
        s.date_key AS dt,
        s.app_id,
        s.channel,
        ch.dept_id,
        ch.dept_name,
        ap.paid_type,
        s.new_user,
        s.recharge_amount
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_channel_summary_d_d s
    INNER JOIN channel_dept ch
        ON s.app_id = ch.app_id
       AND s.channel = ch.channel_code
    LEFT JOIN app_dim ap
        ON s.app_id = ap.app_code
    CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
    WHERE s.date_key >= TO_DATE(pb.week_start_dt)
      AND s.date_key <= TO_DATE(LEAST(pb.week_end_dt, pb.biz_dt))
),
new_agg AS (
    SELECT
        channel,
        dept_id,
        MAX(app_id) AS app_id,
        MAX(dept_name) AS dept_name,
        MAX(paid_type) AS paid_type,
        SUM(COALESCE(new_user, 0)) AS week_new_user_num,
        CAST(SUM(COALESCE(recharge_amount, 0)) AS BIGINT) AS week_recharge_amt
    FROM metrics_daily
    GROUP BY channel, dept_id
),
-- 3) 周次留：运营留存 day1_ret_cnt；注册日∈[周一, min(周日,业务日-1)]；按渠道日计数后相加
retention_day AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(r.dt) AS dt,
        r.channel,
        ch.dept_id,
        bm_count(bm_merge(r.day1_ret_cnt)) AS day1_cnt
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_retention_d_h r
    INNER JOIN channel_dept ch
        ON r.app_code = ch.app_id
       AND r.channel = ch.channel_code
    CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
    WHERE TO_DATE(r.dt) >= TO_DATE(pb.week_start_dt)
      AND TO_DATE(r.dt) <= DATE_SUB(TO_DATE(LEAST(pb.week_end_dt, pb.biz_dt)), 1)
    GROUP BY TO_DATE(r.dt), r.channel, ch.dept_id
),
retention_agg AS (
    SELECT
        channel,
        dept_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(day1_cnt, 0)) AS week_retention_user_num
    FROM retention_day
    GROUP BY channel, dept_id
),
-- 4) 周日均活跃：每天按渠道×部门合并 active_users 计数，再按有数天平均
day_dau AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(u.dt) AS dt,
        u.channel,
        ch.dept_id,
        bm_count(bm_merge(u.active_users)) AS dau
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_user_d_h u
    INNER JOIN channel_dept ch
        ON u.app_code = ch.app_id
       AND u.channel = ch.channel_code
    CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
    WHERE TO_DATE(u.dt) >= TO_DATE(pb.week_start_dt)
      AND TO_DATE(u.dt) <= TO_DATE(LEAST(pb.week_end_dt, pb.biz_dt))
    GROUP BY TO_DATE(u.dt), u.channel, ch.dept_id
),
dau_avg AS (
    SELECT
        channel,
        dept_id,
        CAST(ROUND(AVG(dau)) AS BIGINT) AS week_avg_dau
    FROM day_dau
    GROUP BY channel, dept_id
),
key_set AS (
    SELECT channel, dept_id FROM new_agg
    UNION
    SELECT channel, dept_id FROM dau_avg
    UNION
    SELECT channel, dept_id FROM retention_agg
)
SELECT
    pb.week_start_dt,
    k.channel,
    k.dept_id,
    pb.week_end_dt,
    n.app_id,
    n.dept_name,
    n.paid_type,
    COALESCE(n.week_new_user_num, 0) AS week_new_user_num,
    COALESCE(n.week_recharge_amt, 0) AS week_recharge_amt,
    COALESCE(r.week_retention_user_num, 0) AS week_retention_user_num,
    COALESCE(d.week_avg_dau, 0) AS week_avg_dau,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS update_time
FROM key_set k
CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
LEFT JOIN new_agg n ON k.channel = n.channel AND k.dept_id = n.dept_id
LEFT JOIN retention_agg r ON k.channel = r.channel AND k.dept_id = r.dept_id
LEFT JOIN dau_avg d ON k.channel = d.channel AND k.dept_id = d.dept_id
;

),
retention_day AS (
  SELECT r.channel, ch.dept_id,
         BITMAP_COUNT(BITMAP_UNION(r.day1_ret_cnt)) AS day1_cnt
  FROM dws.dws_app_retention_d_h r
  INNER JOIN channel_dept ch ON r.app_code = ch.app_id AND r.channel = ch.channel_code
  CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
  WHERE r.dt BETWEEN pb.week_start_dt AND DATE(LEAST(DATE(pb.week_end_dt), DATE(DATE_SUB(pb.biz_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY))))
  GROUP BY r.dt, r.channel, ch.dept_id
),
retention_agg AS (
  SELECT channel, dept_id, SUM(COALESCE(day1_cnt,0)) AS week_retention_user_num
  FROM retention_day GROUP BY channel, dept_id
),
day_dau AS (
  SELECT u.channel, ch.dept_id,
         BITMAP_COUNT(BITMAP_UNION(u.active_users)) AS dau
  FROM dws.dws_app_user_d_h u
  INNER JOIN channel_dept ch ON u.app_code = ch.app_id AND u.channel = ch.channel_code
  CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
  WHERE u.dt BETWEEN pb.week_start_dt AND DATE(LEAST(DATE(pb.week_end_dt), DATE(pb.biz_dt)))
  GROUP BY u.dt, u.channel, ch.dept_id
),
dau_avg AS (
  SELECT channel, dept_id, CAST(ROUND(AVG(dau)) AS BIGINT) AS week_avg_dau
  FROM day_dau GROUP BY channel, dept_id
),
new_v AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(n.channel, r.channel, d.channel) AS channel,
         COALESCE(n.dept_id, r.dept_id, d.dept_id) AS dept_id,
         COALESCE(n.week_new_user_num,0) AS week_new_user_num,
         COALESCE(n.week_recharge_amt,0) AS week_recharge_amt,
         COALESCE(r.week_retention_user_num,0) AS week_retention_user_num,
         COALESCE(d.week_avg_dau,0) AS week_avg_dau
  FROM new_agg n
  FULL OUTER JOIN retention_agg r ON n.channel=r.channel AND n.dept_id=r.dept_id
  FULL OUTER JOIN dau_avg d ON COALESCE(n.channel,r.channel)=d.channel AND COALESCE(n.dept_id,r.dept_id)=d.dept_id
),
old_v AS (
  SELECT channel, dept_id, week_new_user_num, week_recharge_amt, week_retention_user_num, week_avg_dau
  FROM ads.ads_dept_promotion_summary_w WHERE week_start_dt='2026-10-26'
)
SELECT 'old' AS tag, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(week_new_user_num) nu, SUM(week_recharge_amt) amt, SUM(week_retention_user_num) ret, SUM(week_avg_dau) dau FROM old_v
UNION ALL
SELECT 'new', COUNT(*), SUM(week_new_user_num), SUM(week_recharge_amt), SUM(week_retention_user_num), SUM(week_avg_dau) FROM new_v

WITH period_bounds AS (
  SELECT d.start_of_week AS week_start_dt,
         DATE(DATE_ADD(d.start_of_week, INTERVAL 6 DAY)) AS week_end_dt,
         DATE('2026-11-01') AS biz_dt
  FROM dim.dim_date_info_all d WHERE d.dt = DATE('2026-11-01')
),
channel_dept AS (
  SELECT app_id, channel_code, dept_id, dept_name, promote_start_date, promote_end_date
  FROM (
    SELECT app_id, channel_code, dept_id, dept_name, promote_start_date, promote_end_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id, channel_code ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn
    FROM dim.dim_channel_info_all WHERE dept_id IS NOT NULL
  ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
metrics_daily AS (
  SELECT s.app_id, ch.dept_id, s.new_user, s.recharge_amount
  FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_channel_summary_d_d s
  INNER JOIN channel_dept ch ON s.app_id = ch.app_id AND s.channel = ch.channel_code
  CROSS JOIN period_bounds pb
  WHERE s.date_key BETWEEN pb.week_start_dt AND DATE(LEAST(DATE(pb.week_end_dt), DATE(pb.biz_dt)))
    AND ch.promote_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.date_key >= ch.promote_start_date
    AND (ch.promote_end_date IS NULL OR s.date_key <= ch.promote_end_date)
),
new_agg AS (
  SELECT dept_id, app_id, SUM(COALESCE(new_user,0)) AS nu, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(recharge_amount,0)) AS BIGINT) AS amt
  FROM metrics_daily GROUP BY dept_id, app_id
),
old_v AS (
  SELECT dept_id, app_id, week_new_user_num AS nu, week_recharge_amt AS amt
  FROM ads.ads_product_promotion_summary_w WHERE week_start_dt='2026-10-26'
)
SELECT o.dept_id, o.app_id, o.nu old_nu, n.nu new_nu, o.nu-COALESCE(n.nu,0) d_nu,
       o.amt old_amt, n.amt new_amt, o.amt-COALESCE(n.amt,0) d_amt
FROM old_v o
LEFT JOIN new_agg n ON o.dept_id=n.dept_id AND o.app_id=n.app_id
ORDER BY ABS(o.nu-COALESCE(n.nu,0)) DESC
LIMIT 8
